import zlib,struct
def dec(path):
    d=open(path,'rb').read(); p=8; idat=b''
    while p<len(d):
        L,=struct.unpack('>I',d[p:p+4]); t=d[p+4:p+8]; c=d[p+8:p+8+L]
        if t==b'IDAT': idat+=c
        p+=12+L
    raw=zlib.decompress(idat); W=256; bpr=32
    rows=[]; prev=bytearray(bpr); k=0
    for y in range(256):
        f=raw[k]; line=bytearray(raw[k+1:k+1+bpr]); k+=1+bpr
        for i in range(bpr):
            a=line[i-1] if i>=1 else 0; b=prev[i]; c_=prev[i-1] if i>=1 else 0
            if f==1: line[i]=(line[i]+a)&255
            elif f==2: line[i]=(line[i]+b)&255
            elif f==3: line[i]=(line[i]+((a+b)>>1))&255
            elif f==4:

                pr=a if pa<=pb and pa<=pc else (b if pb<=pc else c_)
                line[i]=(line[i]+pr)&255
        rows.append(bytes(line)); prev=line
    return rows
